'''''Ash vs Evil Dead''''' is an American [[comedy horror]] television series developed by [[Sam Raimi]], [[Ivan Raimi]], and [[Tom Spezialy]] for [[Starz (TV channel)|Starz]]. The series is a sequel to the original ''[[Evil Dead]]'' trilogy created by Raimi, with [[Bruce Campbell]] reprising his role as [[Ash Williams]]. [[Ray Santiago]], [[Dana DeLorenzo]], and [[Lucy Lawless]] also star.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Ng |first=Philiana |date=10 November 2014 |title=Starz Orders 'Evil Dead' TV Series |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/starz-orders-evil-dead-tv-747919 |magazine=The Hollywood Reporter |access-date=28 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160506014354/http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/starz-orders-evil-dead-tv-747919 |archive-date=May 6, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref>

The series premiered on October 31, 2015. Three days before the series premiere, Starz renewed it for a second season, which premiered on October 2, 2016. Starz renewed it for a third season,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2016/10/ash-vs-evil-dead-renewed-season-3-starz-bruce-campbell-new-york-comic-con-1201832803/ |title=Starz Renews 'Ash Vs. Evil Dead' For Third Season – NY Comic-Con |last=Patten |first=Dominic |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=October 7, 2016 |access-date=October 8, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161008153522/http://deadline.com/2016/10/ash-vs-evil-dead-renewed-season-3-starz-bruce-campbell-new-york-comic-con-1201832803/ |archive-date=October 8, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref> which premiered on February 25, 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2017/10/ash-vs-evil-dead-starz-season-three-premiere-1202182407/ |title=Starz's 'Ash Vs. Evil Dead' Sets Season 3 Premiere Date |last=Evans |first=Greg |date=October 5, 2017 |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=October 26, 2017 |language=en-US |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171026054119/http://deadline.com/2017/10/ash-vs-evil-dead-starz-season-three-premiere-1202182407/ |archive-date=October 26, 2017 |url-status=live }}</ref> The series was canceled after three seasons on April 29, 2018.<ref name=varietycancellation>{{Cite news|url=https://variety.com/2018/tv/news/ash-vs-evil-dead-canceled-starz-1202775341/|title='Ash vs. Evil Dead' Canceled at Starz After Three Seasons|last=Otterson|first=Joe|date=2018-04-20|work=Variety|access-date=2018-04-20|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180620124954/https://variety.com/2018/tv/news/ash-vs-evil-dead-canceled-starz-1202775341/|archive-date=June 20, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Premise==
The series is set approximately 30 years after [[Ash Williams]] returned from 1300 AD at the end of ''[[Army of Darkness]]'' (1992). He works at the "Value Stop" as a simple stock boy. Also working at the store is his friend Pablo and the object of Pablo's affections, Kelly. Ash has seemingly done very little with his life since his battles with the Deadites and lives in a trailer and drinks alone in bars. However, Ash must soon renounce his routine existence and become a hero once more by taking up arms and facing the titular Evil Dead. Pablo and Kelly decide to join him on his quest to save humanity.

==Cast==
===Main===
* [[Bruce Campbell]] as [[Ash Williams]]: A survivor of several attacks by the Evil Dead three decades earlier. In an interview with ''[[Entertainment Weekly]]'', Campbell stated, "Ash has survivor's guilt. You could have a heyday with his [[PTSD]]. He's a war vet. He doesn't want to talk about it, and he'll lie about that stump on his hand to impress the ladies. This is a guy who's got some issues. He's emotionally stunted. But, he's the guy you want in the foxhole next to you."<ref>{{cite magazine |url=https://www.ew.com/article/2014/12/22/evil-dead-bruce-campbell-interview |last=Hibberd |first=James |magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]] |title='Evil Dead' scoop: Bruce Campbell reveals series details |access-date=November 1, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151026235940/http://www.ew.com/article/2014/12/22/evil-dead-bruce-campbell-interview |archive-date=October 26, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> Over the course of season one, it is revealed that following the events of the film trilogy, Ash spent thirty years drifting from town to town, living in a [[Airstream|mobile home trailer]], with his pet lizard, Eli, and working a series of dead-end jobs at different branches of Value Stop. Ash has attempted to destroy the Necronomicon on multiple occasions. Unable to be rid of the book, he instead becomes its de facto caretaker. In season two, it is revealed that Ash had returned to his hometown of Elk Grove, [[Michigan]], after the events of the films. The people of Elk Grove refused to believe his stories of Deadites, and instead accused him of murdering his friends and his sister in the cabin, shunned him, and dubbed him "Ashy Slashy".
* [[Ray Santiago]] as Pablo Simon Bolivar:<ref name="auto2">{{cite magazine |last=Maas |first=Jennifer |date=11 February 2015 |title=Ray Santiago, Dana DeLorenzo join Ash vs Evil Dead |url=https://www.ew.com/article/2015/02/11/ray-santiago-dana-delorenzo-join-ash-vs-evil-dead |magazine=Entertainment Weekly |access-date=28 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150512174139/http://www.ew.com/article/2015/02/11/ray-santiago-dana-delorenzo-join-ash-vs-evil-dead |archive-date=May 12, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> A co-worker who became Ash's loyal sidekick. Pablo believes that Ash is a true hero and calls him "El Jefe" ("The Boss") as a mark of respect. Santiago describes his character as an "El Jefe in-training". He was raised by his uncle, [[Wiktionary:brujo|"el Brujo"]], a [[shaman]], who told him stories of an evil power which can only be defeated by "El Jefe". He fights valiantly alongside Ash and Kelly before being torn to ribbons by the demon [[Baal]], but was resurrected thereafter. Through a ritual in season 3, Pablo succeeds his uncle as a "brujo especial".
* [[Dana DeLorenzo]] as Kelly Maxwell / Sorceress Kaya:<ref name="bloodydisgusting2">{{cite web |url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3332082/breaking-ash-vs-evil-dead-casting-details/ |title=Breaking: "Ash Vs Evil Dead" Casting and Details! |website=Bloody Disgusting |author=Mr Disgusting |date=February 11, 2015 |access-date=May 26, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160610155011/http://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3332082/breaking-ash-vs-evil-dead-casting-details/ |archive-date=June 10, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref> An occasionally moody and initially reluctant co-worker of Ash and Pablo, Kelly is dragged into the fight against evil after she is orphaned. She is often described as a spiritual daughter of Ash. Impulsive but really good at fighting and improvisation. She is a crucial member of the "Ghostbeaters". She and her family are Jewish. Her mother died in a car accident six months prior to the beginning of the series.
* [[Jill Marie Jones]] as Amanda Fisher (season 1):<ref name="auto1">{{cite web |url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3333101/leading-actress-announced-ash-vs-evil-dead/ |title=Lead Actress Announced for 'Ash Vs Evil Dead'! |website=[[Bloody Disgusting]] |first=Sean |last=Decker |date=February 11, 2015 |access-date=May 26, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303192534/http://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3333101/leading-actress-announced-ash-vs-evil-dead/ |archive-date=March 3, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref> A [[Michigan State Trooper]] who set out to find Ash following the death of her partner.
* [[Lucy Lawless]] as Ruby Knowby / Rebecca Prevett:<ref name="auto3">{{cite magazine |url=https://hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/lucy-lawless-evil-dead-sequel-780161 |title=Lucy Lawless to Co-Star in 'Evil Dead' Sequel |magazine=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |last=Goldberg |first=Lesley |date=March 9, 2015 |access-date=May 26, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150626122513/http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/lucy-lawless-evil-dead-sequel-780161 |archive-date=June 26, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> A mysterious figure who is on a quest to hunt down the source of the recent evil outbreaks.
* [[Michelle Hurd]] as Linda Bates-Emery (season 2): Ash's high school girlfriend who is now married to Emery, the sheriff of Elk Grove, and has a daughter, Lacey. She is one of the few people in Elk Grove happy to see Ash return.
* [[Ted Raimi]] as Chet Kaminski (season 2): A hard-partying old childhood friend of Ash's who was secretly intimate with Ash's sister, Cheryl, thirty years prior, and pays the ultimate price for it. Raimi had previously appeared throughout the ''Evil Dead'' series in various cameo and [[fake Shemp|stand-in]] roles.
* Arielle Carver-O'Neill as Brandy Barr Williams (season 3): Ash's long-lost daughter, a smart middle-class American high school senior whose life is upended when she finds herself caught up in violent demonic events that result in her mother's death.
* [[Lindsay Farris]] as Dalton (season 3): A member of the Knights of Sumeria, an ancient order dedicated to battling evil.

===Recurring===
* [[Samara Weaving]] as Heather (season 1): The sole survivor of a hiking group, she is rescued by Pablo and Kelly when they reach the cabin. She is later indirectly killed by Ruby when the evil is set loose.
* [[Indiana Evans]] as Melissa (season 1): A member of the hiking group, Brad's wife, and Heather's friend. She is killed by Deadite Amanda.
* [[Ido Drent]] as Brad (season 1): Melissa's husband who is killed by Deadite Amanda while his hiking group tries to help Pablo and Kelly find the cabin.
* [[Hemky Madera]] as El Brujo (season 1, 3): Pablo's shaman uncle, Ash, Pablo and Kelly go to him for help against the Kandarian Demon. He is killed by the demon Eligos when he performs an exorcism on Kelly to release her from Eligos' thrall.
* [[Lee Majors]] as Brock Williams (season 2–3): Ash's father, whom Ash has not seen in 30 or so years, since the events of ''[[The Evil Dead]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2016/02/lee-majors-ted-raimi-join-ash-vs-evil-dead-on-starz-1201700119/ |title='Ash Vs Evil Dead' Adds Lee Majors & Ted Raimi To Season 2 Cast On Starz |first=Denise |last=Petski |date=February 10, 2016 |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=January 13, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180421030456/http://deadline.com/2016/02/lee-majors-ted-raimi-join-ash-vs-evil-dead-on-starz-1201700119/ |archive-date=April 21, 2018 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2016/07/ash-vs-evil-dead-season-2-bruce-campbell-lucy-lawless-comic-con-1201791498/ |title=Lee Majors Makes His Comic-Con Debut At 'Ash Vs Evil Dead' Panel |first=Anthony |last=D'Alessandro |date=July 24, 2016 |website=Deadline Hollywood |access-date=January 13, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180114020454/http://deadline.com/2016/07/ash-vs-evil-dead-season-2-bruce-campbell-lucy-lawless-comic-con-1201791498/ |archive-date=January 14, 2018 |url-status=live }}</ref> It is from his father that Ash got his bad habits ([[wikt:debauchery|debauchery]], etc.), and it's hinted that he has stolen girls/women from Ash in the past (i.e. his son's old high school P.E. teacher, Lillian Pendergrast). His day job is as a [[Household hardware|hardware]] store owner; his slogan is "Brock Williams – [[Innuendo|has wood]] – call me." He blames Ash for the death of his daughter, Cheryl, but then, minutes before being killed by his son's possessed [[Oldsmobile 88]], comes to realize that his boy was actually a hero. He later appears as a spirit to help guide Ash on how to defeat the Deadites.
* [[Stephen Lovatt]] as Sheriff Thomas Emery (season 2): The husband of Linda whom Ash used to pick on in high school. He is now the strict sheriff of Elk Grove.
* [[Joel Tobeck]] as Baal (season 2): A diabolical demon and Ruby's ex-husband who wants the Necronomicon for his own nefarious purposes. His abilities include using lust to manipulate others, possessing human bodies and the ability to slow down time near a target (or just their perception of it) where–in he can converse with or injure said target. When Baal is using this power, nobody seems to be able to see him besides the person he is interacting with. Ruby has also mentioned that he is impervious to physical attacks and can only be harmed through mystic or spiritual means. Ruby also disclosed that she didn't "choose" him when they became a couple, but had used his powers on her. It isn't clear if he is meant as a nod to the [[Baal (demon)|Biblical Baal]] or the [[Baal|Canaanite Baal]].
* [[Pepi Sonuga]] as Lacey Emery (season 2): Thomas' and Linda's 17-year-old daughter who becomes possessed by Kandarian spirits and is killed by Kelly.
*[[Emelia Burns|Emilia Burns]] as Zoë (season 3): a Knight of Sumeria who helps Ash in his crusade.
* Katrina Hobbs as Candace "Candy" Barr-Williams (season 3): An ex-girlfriend of Ash's who is the mother of their daughter Brandy. Ash married Candace in Branson, Missouri when they were drunk, and she never sought a divorce/annulment, leaving them legally married. She was later killed by a deadite before becoming one herself at her own funeral.
* Samantha Young as Natalie (season 3): A woman who Ruby kidnaps and holds hostage to be a sort-of babysitter for her spawn. She is later killed by the demonic baby.

===Special guests===
* Rebekkah Farrell as Linda (season 1)
* [[Ellen Sandweiss]] returning as Cheryl Williams (season 2) from the original ''Evil Dead'' movie.
* [[Nicholas Hope]] as Professor Raymond Knowby (season 2)

* [[Jeffrey Thomas (actor)|Jeffrey Thomas]] as Stanley Gibson (season 3)

==Production==
The series first started life as two competing ideas for a fourth ''Evil Dead'' film.<ref name="observermind">{{cite web |last1=Mancuso |first1=Vinnie |title=Interview: Bruce Campbell and Sam Raimi, The Face and Mind of "Evil Dead" |url=http://observer.com/2015/10/interview-bruce-campbell-and-sam-raimi-the-face-and-mind-of-the-evil-dead/ |website=[[Observer.com]] |date=October 30, 2015 |access-date=7 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160812091902/http://observer.com/2015/10/interview-bruce-campbell-and-sam-raimi-the-face-and-mind-of-the-evil-dead/ |archive-date=August 12, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref> However at the time the Raimi brothers did not know how to get funding for the film and so it was instead written as a TV show. Writing for the medium presented new challenges for Sam as he had to make the series accessible to new viewers as well as create new characters to "bounce off of".<ref name="observermind"/> The project was first officially revealed by Raimi at a surprise appearance at the 2014 [[San Diego Comic-Con]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Robertson |first1=Adi |title=Sam Raimi writing 'Evil Dead' TV series |url=https://www.theverge.com/2014/7/25/5937561/sam-raimi-evil-dead-tv-series-last-of-us-comic-con |website=[[The Verge]] |date=July 25, 2014 |access-date=7 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171003075439/https://www.theverge.com/2014/7/25/5937561/sam-raimi-evil-dead-tv-series-last-of-us-comic-con |archive-date=October 3, 2017 |url-status=live }}</ref> That November, Starz announced that they officially put an order in for the series.<ref>{{cite magazine |last1=Prudom |first1=Laura |title=Starz Orders 'Evil Dead' Sequel Series for 2015 |url=https://variety.com/2014/tv/news/evil-dead-series-starz-ash-bruce-campbell-1201352764/ |magazine=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |access-date=7 June 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180114020550/https://variety.com/2014/tv/news/evil-dead-series-starz-ash-bruce-campbell-1201352764/ |archive-date=January 14, 2018 |url-status=live }}</ref> Campbell said the channel was the only network that would give them the ability to be unrated and unrestricted; Campbell has stated that Starz does not require the crew to create alternate, "wimpy" versions for television.<ref>{{cite magazine |url=http://www.papermag.com/return-of-the-chin-1440514601.html |title=Bruce Campbell On Ash vs Evil Dead, Fargo and Why He's Not As Typecast As You Think |first=Michael |last=Tedder |date=November 5, 2015 |magazine=[[Paper (magazine)|Paper]] |access-date=November 5, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151107221210/http://www.papermag.com/return-of-the-chin-1440514601.html |archive-date=November 7, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref>

The pilot episode of the series was written by Sam Raimi (who also directed), Ivan Raimi and Tom Spezialy.<ref name="dreadcentral">{{cite web |url=https://www.dreadcentral.com/news/90298/exclusive-bruce-campbell-talks-ash-vs-evil-dead-dread-central/ |title=Bruce Campbell Talks Ash vs Evil Dead with Dread Central |website=Dread Central |first=Sean |last=Decker |date=February 11, 2015 |access-date=May 26, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150531103414/http://www.dreadcentral.com/news/90298/exclusive-bruce-campbell-talks-ash-vs-evil-dead-dread-central/ |archive-date=May 31, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> In February 2015, original film series producer [[Robert Tapert]] returned to produce along with Raimi, Campbell and Craig DiGregorio. [[Ray Santiago]] and [[Dana DeLorenzo]] were cast in the lead roles of Pablo Simon Bolivar and Kelly Maxwell, and [[Jill Marie Jones]] was cast as Amanda Fisher, a Michigan State Trooper.<ref name="dreadcentral" /><ref name="auto1"/> In March 2015, [[Lucy Lawless]] was cast as Ruby, a mysterious figure who's on a quest to stop the evil outbreak and believes that Ash is the one who's the cause of it.<ref name="auto3"/> In April 2015, Starz released a new graphic teaser advertising the TV show is coming in the fall of 2015, along with a new poster for the series.<ref name=":0">{{cite web |last1=Lealos |first1=Shawn |title=Ash vs Evil Dead Teaser |url=http://renegadecinema.com/36485/ash-vs-evil-dead-teaser |website=Renegade Cinema |access-date=April 3, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150409072756/http://renegadecinema.com/36485/ash-vs-evil-dead-teaser |archive-date=April 9, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> Filming commenced in Auckland, New Zealand later that month.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://tvtrippin.com/tv/old-friends-in-new-zealand-on-the-set-of-ash-vs-evil-dead/ |title=On the set of 'Ash vs Evil Dead' in New Zealand |first=Lori |last=Rackl |date=July 10, 2015 |website=TV Trippin.com |access-date=January 13, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160327084451/http://tvtrippin.com/tv/old-friends-in-new-zealand-on-the-set-of-ash-vs-evil-dead/ |archive-date=March 27, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Due to legal issues with [[Universal Pictures]], the events from ''[[Army of Darkness]]'' could not specifically be mentioned in the first season.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3357283/doesnt-ash-work-s-mart-ash-vs-evil-dead/ |title="Ash vs Evil Dead": Why Doesn't Ash Work At S-Mart? |first=Brad |last=Miska |date=August 14, 2015 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2015/11/07/ash-vs-evil-dead-showrunner-on-ashs-zero-progression-his-time-travel-history-and-more |title=Ash vs Evil Dead showrunner on Ash's |archive-date=January 22, 2016 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lIImIAqf90 |title=Bruce Campbell on Making 'Ash vs. Evil Dead' without the Rights to 'Army of Darkness' |language=en |date=October 26, 2015 |author=Collider Videos |via=YouTube |minutes=2:23}}</ref> and in mid-2016, producer Robert Tapert stated that the rights issue had been solved == Marketing ==
During the [[2016 United States elections|2016 election of United States]], Starz made a fictional web [[Political campaign|campaign]] on Youtube to promote the second season of the show called "Ash For President", where Ash promised to transform the White House into a party house and campaign subscribers received gifts related to the character.<ref name=":0" />

==Online hoax==
In June 2016, a [[Facebook]] user posted a photo of a bruised, bloodied, and scratched [[Samara Weaving]] (without identifying that the woman in the image was Weaving or any actress). The photo was accompanied by the caption "The result of Fascism in America...simply because she was a Trump supporter."<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.buzzfeed.com/craigsilverman/samara-weaving-trump-hoax-photo|title="This Actress Is Not Happy Her Photo Is Being Used In A Hoax About Trump Fans"|date=June 8, 2016|work=[[BuzzFeed]]|accessdate=July 26, 2017}}</ref> Although some news outlets<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.sfgate.com/news/local/article/Trump-supporters-are-stealing-photos-to-show-the-7970401.php|title="Donald Trump fans duped into thinking Samara Weaving's bloody photo is of beaten supporter"|date=June 8, 2016|work=[[SFGate]]|accessdate=July 26, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.nzherald.co.nz/entertainment/news/article.cfm?c_id=1501119&objectid=11652961|title="Trump supporters are claiming Samara Weaving is a victim of anti-Trumpers"date=June 8, 2016|work=[[]New Zealand Herald]]|accessdate=July 26, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://thenewdaily.com.au/entertainment/celebrity/2016/06/08/samara-weaving-donald-trump-ad/|title="Samara Weaving caught in Donald Trump hoax"|date=June 8, 2016|work=[[The New Daily]]|accessdate=July 26, 2017|archive-date=November 24, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181124124554/https://thenewdaily.com.au/entertainment/celebrity/2016/06/08/samara-weaving-donald-trump-ad/|url-status=dead}}</ref> clarified that the photo was of Samara Weaving and that she was not really injured, many supporters of then-candidate [[Donald Trump]] were convinced that the image was proof of liberal violence against Trump supporters. In support of this misinterpretation of the photo, the post was shared close to 30,000 times. To try to counter this misinformation, ''Ash vs Evil Dead'' star [[Bruce Campbell]] tweeted, "Check your facts, folks. This is an actress named Samara Weaving from #AshVsEvilDead. This is a make-up test. Sad."<ref>{{cite news|url=https://twitter.com/groovybruce/status/740388115475369985?lang=en|website=Twitter|title=Check your facts, folks. This is an actress named Samara Weaving from #AshVsEvilDead. This is a make-up test. Sad.|accessdate=June 2, 2022}}</ref> Weaving herself tweeted, "I really hate this."<ref>{{cite tweet|number=740392579389370370|user=Sweaving|title=I really hate this.|date=June 8, 2016}}</ref>

==Cancellation==
It was announced on April 20, 2018, that ''Ash vs Evil Dead'' had been canceled after a three-season run, with the last episode airing on April 29, 2018.<ref name=varietycancellation /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/ash-evil-dead-canceled-at-starz-1104557|title='Ash vs. Evil Dead' Canceled at Starz|author=Lesley Goldberg|date=April 20, 2018|website=hollywoodreporter.com|publisher=The Hollywood Reporter|access-date=May 6, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180507085440/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/ash-evil-dead-canceled-at-starz-1104557|archive-date=May 7, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> Towards the end of the third season, ratings had declined from the initial 437,000 same-day viewers of the first season to around 175,000 non-[[Digital video recorder|DVR]] viewers.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://collider.com/ash-vs-evil-dead-cancelled/|title=Ash vs. Evil Dead Cancelled at Starz After Season 3|author=Haleigh Foutch|website=[[Collider (website)|Collider]]|date=April 20, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180506163648/http://collider.com/ash-vs-evil-dead-cancelled/|archive-date=May 6, 2018|access-date=May 6, 2018}}</ref> According to ''[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]'', at the time of the eighth episode of the third season's airing, the show averaged a 0.08 rating in adults aged 18 to 49, with approximately 177,000 viewers per episode.<ref name=varietycancellation />

Bruce Campbell stated at the time of the cancellation that "''Ash vs. Evil Dead'' has been the ride of a lifetime. Ash Williams was the role of a lifetime. It was an honor to reunite with ''Evil Dead'' partners Rob Tapert and Sam Raimi to give our tireless fans another taste of the outrageous horror/comedy they demanded. I will always be grateful to Starz for the opportunity to revisit the franchise that launched our careers".<ref name=ewretire>{{cite web|url=https://ew.com/tv/2018/04/23/bruce-campbell-ash-vs-evil-dead/|title=Ash vs. Evil Dead star Bruce Campbell says he's 'retired' from playing Ash|author=Clark Collis|date=April 23, 2018|publisher=Entertainment Weekly|access-date=May 6, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180507003439/http://ew.com/tv/2018/04/23/bruce-campbell-ash-vs-evil-dead/|archive-date=May 7, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> Following the news of the show's cancellation, fans of the series created petitions to renew ''Ash vs Evil Dead'' for a fourth or fifth season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/tv/3495118/heres-can-let-netflix-know-want-pick-ash-vs-evil-dead/|title=Here's How You Can Let Netflix Know You Want Them to Pick Up "Ash vs. Evil Dead"|author=John Squires|date=April 23, 2018|website=Bloody Disgusting|access-date=May 6, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180507003228/http://bloody-disgusting.com/tv/3495118/heres-can-let-netflix-know-want-pick-ash-vs-evil-dead/|archive-date=May 7, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dreadcentral.com/news/255541/fans-create-petition-renew-ash-vs-evil-dead-seasons-4-5/|title=Fans Create Petition to Renew Ash vs Evil Dead For Seasons 4 & 5|author=Mike Sprague|date=October 10, 2017|website=Dread Central|access-date=May 6, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180507003137/http://www.dreadcentral.com/news/255541/fans-create-petition-renew-ash-vs-evil-dead-seasons-4-5/|archive-date=May 7, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> In response to an article published by the website [[Bloody Disgusting]] that encouraged fans to campaign for the show's continuation on the [[Netflix]] platform, Campbell [[Twitter|tweeted]] "Big props to fans for the effort, but I'm retired as Ash. #timetofrysomeotherfish".<ref name="ewretire" />

Later, Campbell said about the show's cancellation and legacy: "I'm really glad we did it because we saw Ash's home, we went into his bedroom, we met his girlfriends, we met his daughter that we never knew he had and that he never knew he had, and we met his father, played by the great Lee Majors. I feel we really pushed all the buttons and he fulfilled his destiny written in that ancient book. He was the guy destined to defeat evil in the past, present and future, and he took off with a hot robot chick at the end to go kick in the future. What else do you need? We knew the ratings were bad. We knew, going into the last season, that we had to have an end because we didn't think Starz was gonna re-up us and we were right. So, thank God we did that."<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://collider.com/bruce-campbell-evil-dead-ash-comments/|title="It's Time to Hang up the Chainsaw": Bruce Campbell on Why He's Done Playing Ash in the 'Evil Dead' Franchise|website=[[Collider (website)|Collider]]|date=November 26, 2021}}</ref>

Campbell and Raimi signed on as producers of the film ''[[Evil Dead Rise]],'' though Campbell did not star in the film. The cinematographer of ''Ash vs Evil Dead'', Dave Garbett, served as cinematographer on ''Evil Dead Rise''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cbr.com/evil-dead-rise-director-tease-photo/ |title=Evil Dead Rise Director Teases Start of Filming With BTS Photo |last=Laman |first=Douglas |website=[[Comic Book Resources]] |date=June 7, 2021|access-date=June 7, 2021}}</ref>

=== Cancelled revival ===
On July 25, 2022, Campbell announced that an animated [[Revival (television)|revival]] of ''Ash vs Evil Dead'' was in active development, with Campbell returning as the voice of Ash.<ref name="revival">{{cite web |url=https://collider.com/ash-vs-evil-dead-animated-series-bruce-campbell-comments/ | title=Bruce Campbell Confirms 'Ash vs. Evil Dead' Animated Series Talks Have Begun | website=[[Collider (website)|Collider]] | date=July 25, 2022 }}</ref> On July 26, 2024, Campbell confirmed the series was still in the works and suggested he was still set to voice Ash; however, three months later on October 29, 2024, he revealed the series was no longer intended as a continuation of ''Ash vs Evil Dead''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Why Bruce Campbell thinks 'Die Hard' got the premise wrong |url=https://ew.com/bruce-campbell-says-die-hard-got-the-premise-wrong-8684731 |access-date=2024-08-16 |website=EW.com |language=en}}</ref><ref name="ForbesCampbell">{{cite web |title="Bruce Campbell Drops New Hints About Evil Dead Animated Series" |website=[[Forbes]] |date=October 29, 2024 |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/timlammers/2024/10/29/bruce-campbell-drops-new-hints-about-evil-dead-animated-series/
 |access-date=October 14, 2025}}</ref> On August 15, 2026, Campbell confirmed that the animated revival was no longer happening as he is officially retired as Ash in both live action and animation.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hermanns |first=Grant |date=2026-08-15 |title=Ash Williams' Evil Dead Return Fate Officially Sealed By Bruce Campbell 4 Years After Revival Announcement |url=https://screenrant.com/ash-williams-evil-dead-return-fate-sealed-bruce-campbell/ |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=ScreenRant |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Hermanns |first=Grant |date=2026-08-16 |title=Bruce Campbell's Evil Dead Burn Cameo & Future Involvement In Sam Raimi's Franchise Clarified |url=https://screenrant.com/evil-dead-burn-cameo-franchise-future-clarified-bruce-campbell/ |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=ScreenRant |language=en}}</ref>

 |ShortSummary = Before Ash can react to what is going on, Amanda returns and attacks him. He manages to defeat her but notices Ruby and Pablo have disappeared into the cellar. He goes down to find them but the Kandarian force pounds the cabin and Ash falls down the steps. He suddenly finds himself back in his trailer with the ''Necronomicon''. Ruby appears and tells him that he was destined to stand against her, and then tries to broker a truce by offering him what he desires the most – a peaceful retirement in Jacksonville. Refusing the offer, Ash finds himself back in the cellar and under attack by a demonic child that was belched up by Pablo who is under the control of the Necronomicon. Meanwhile, Kelly and Heather attempt to survive a demonic onslaught. Heather is killed while Kelly is locked out of the cabin. Ash again confronts Ruby, who promises to leave Ash and his friends alone in exchange for allowing her to release evil spirits (which she claims she can control) from the Necronomicon. Ash accepts the deal and starts driving to Jacksonville with Kelly and Pablo, while sinkholes begin to open up around the world.

While searching around town for Ruby, Ash encounters his former love, Linda Bates, who is married to the town's sheriff, Thomas Emery. Emery mocks Ash, and promises to take him in when he can. Pablo receives a vision, prompting the gang to head to the town's crematorium, where Ash finds an injured Ruby, claiming that her children have betrayed her, forcing her to hide the Necronomicon. After saving her from her three demon children, Ash and Ruby form a temporary alliance.

 |ShortSummary = Distraught over the loss of Pablo, Ash and the gang attempt to travel back in time to ensure that young Ash will never see the Necronomicon. They return to the year 1982, before young Ash went to the cabin. As they travel to the woods, the gang is chased down by the Kandarian Demon, even though no one had read from the book yet. Ruby and Kelly are separated from Ash in the escape, who runs into the cabin. After a brief altercation with an evil foetus that attempts to infect Ash from his leg, Ash hears a faint voice crying for help from the cellar. He finds the voice to be coming from Henrietta Knowby, who claims to have been trapped and tortured here by her husband. While initially not believing her, Ash eventually discovers as Professor Knowby returns with one of his students, Tanya, who he plans to use to transfer the Kandarian Demon from within Henrietta onto her. Ash then frees Henrietta, just as he realizes he's been tricked, allowing her to run amok. In the midst of the chaos, Professor Knowby escapes with the Necronomicon and locks Ash and Tanya down in the cellar with Henrietta. Meanwhile, Ruby and Kelly are attacked by possessed trees, as well as being followed by a mysterious being.

 |WrittenBy = Luke Kalteux
 |OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2016|12|11}}
 |Viewers =0.269<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.showbuzzdaily.com/articles/showbuzzdailys-top-150-sunday-cable-originals-network-finals-12-11-2016.html |title=Updated: Showbuzzdaily's Top 150 Sunday Cable Originals & Network Finals: 12.11.2016 |last=Metcalf |first=Mitch |access-date=December 13, 2016 |website=Showbuzzdaily |date=December 13, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170825062259/http://www.showbuzzdaily.com/articles/showbuzzdailys-top-150-sunday-cable-originals-network-finals-12-11-2016.html |archive-date=August 25, 2017 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
 |ShortSummary = As Professor Knowby attempts to escape the cabin, he is killed by the Ruby of year 1982, who then retrieves the Necronomicon. Henrietta murders Tanya, and battles Ash, but is ultimately defeated. As Ash reunites with present-day Ruby and Kelly, past Ruby learns of their involvement and then kills present-day Ruby, while Ash and Kelly attempt to escape. The effects of the timeline alteration take place as Ash notices the return of his missing right hand, and Pablo seemingly returning to life. However, he turns out to be Baal, who has secretly taken over Pablo's corpse rather than being banished and reveals they are not actually in the direct past; but rather an alternate timeline where only Knowby found the book. Baal and the alternate Ruby take Ash and Kelly back to the cabin, where they begin to perform rituals to give birth to their spawns. Ash proposes a fair fight between him and Baal, without the use of any magic or weapon. Baal gains the upper hand by using his powers to change form into Chet, Cheryl and Brock, tricking Ash and removing his right hand once more. As Baal prepares to execute Ash, however, he is outwitted and defeated. As the cabin begins to burn down and crumble, Baal, Ruby, their spawns, and the Necronomicon are seemingly banished to the Neitherworld (Hell) as part of the deal, while Pablo is brought back to life. Ash and his friends returns to their timeline, where Elk Grove reveres him as a hero, while the alternate Ruby (somehow having escaped her timeline) watches him from afar. In a post-credit scene, the Necronomicon is picked up by an unknown traveler from the remains of the cabin.
 |LineColor = AED5E6
}}}}

 |Viewers = 0.176<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.showbuzzdaily.com/articles/showbuzzdailys-top-150-sunday-cable-originals-network-finals-3-18-2018.html|title=Updated: ShowBuzzDaily's Top 150 Sunday Cable Originals & Network Finals: 3.18.2018|last=Metcalf|first=Mitch|date=March 20, 2018|work=Showbuzz Daily|access-date=March 20, 2018|archive-url=https://archive.today/20180905201517/http://www.showbuzzdaily.com/articles/showbuzzdailys-top-150-sunday-cable-originals-network-finals-3-18-2018.html|archive-date=September 5, 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref>
 |ShortSummary = Ash is visited by the ghost of the real Brock, who shows him a vision of the past in 2012 when he was visited by a Knight of Sumeria, Gary, who carried the missing pages of the Necronomicon. Brock incapacitated the knight and locked him under the hardware store's cellar after thinking he was dead. Back in present day, Ash enters the cellar and finds the knight's skeleton, as well as Sumerian writing on the wall. Ruby is contacted by the sorceress Kaya, who is imprisoned in the Netherworld. Kaya warns Ruby of the inevitable prophecy and the opening of the Rift. Ruby travels to the Knowby Cabin and finds Dalton, who she temporarily revives in order to learn of what he knew. Dalton reveals to Ruby of their finding of the dagger, but then shoots himself in the head to prevent himself from turning once more. Kelly returns to Ash's home and finds Brandy, who she attempts to convince to stay. They are however attacked by Pablo, who has been possessed by the Kandarian Demon. Ash arrives at Ruby's hideout, where he finds Natalie with Ruby's spawn, which has grown considerably. Ash tries to break Natalie free, but ends up waking the spawn from its sleep.

==Music==
[[Joseph LoDuca]], a frequent Sam Raimi collaborator who composed the scores for the ''[[Evil Dead (franchise)|Evil Dead]]'' films, contributes the original music for ''Ash vs Evil Dead''. The series also leverages excerpts from various 1970s and '80s popular songs, particularly featuring artists (e.g., [[Alice Cooper]], [[Ted Nugent]] and [[Frijid Pink]]) from the greater [[Detroit]] area where much of the action is based (and where Raimi, Campbell and Tapert grew up). Multiple [[Deep Purple]] songs from the 1970s are also used ("Highway Star", "Space Truckin'", "Stormbringer", etc.). In an interview, Sam Raimi states that the music selected for the series is based on the lack of growth of the Ash character over the past 30–35 years, and that "the music should reflect the last time he was engaged in society, and living".<ref name="blastr">{{cite web |url=http://www.blastr.com/2015-11-3/maybe-they-it-sam-raimi-audience-reaction-ash-vs-evil-dead-and-his-own-future-filmmaker |title=Maybe they like it! - Sam Raimi on audience reaction to Ash vs Evil Dead, and his own future as a filmmaker |first=Aaron |last=Sagers |date=November 3, 2015 |website=[[Blastr]] |access-date=November 9, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151108015418/http://www.blastr.com/2015-11-3/maybe-they-it-sam-raimi-audience-reaction-ash-vs-evil-dead-and-his-own-future-filmmaker |archive-date=November 8, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Furthermore, in the season two finale, a marching band plays [[Victory for MSU]], the official fight song of [[Michigan State University]], where Raimi and Tapert attended college.

On November 11, 2015, it was announced that the Joseph LoDuca music score entitled ''Ash vs Evil Dead: Music from the STARZ Original Series'' would be released by [[Varèse Sarabande]] digitally on December 11, 2015, and via audio CD on December 18, 2015.<ref name="score">{{cite web |url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3369664/ash-vs-evil-dead-original-soundtrack-details-revealed-exclusive/ |title="Ash vs Evil Dead" Original Soundtrack Details Revealed [Exclusive] |date=November 11, 2015 |website=[[Bloody Disgusting]] |access-date=November 12, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151114044328/http://bloody-disgusting.com/news/3369664/ash-vs-evil-dead-original-soundtrack-details-revealed-exclusive/ |archive-date=November 14, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="varesescore">{{cite web |url=https://www.varesesarabande.com/products/ash-vs-evil-dead |title=Ash Vs. Evil Dead - Music from the STARZ Original Series - Joseph LoDuca |website=[[Varèse Sarabande]] |access-date=December 10, 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151211092741/https://www.varesesarabande.com/products/ash-vs-evil-dead |archive-date=December 11, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> The following are the tracks that are on that album:<ref name="score"/>

==Reception==
===Critical response===
All three seasons of ''Ash vs Evil Dead'' received critical acclaim. Review aggregator [[Rotten Tomatoes]] gave the season a 98% rating based on 52 reviews, with an average rating of 8.1/10. The site's critical consensus reads, "True to the movies that spawned it, ''Ash vs Evil Dead'' is a gory, hilarious, and audacious resurrection of Sam Raimi's beloved horror franchise."<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/ash-vs-evil-dead/s01/ |title=Ash vs Evil Dead: Season 1 |website=Rotten Tomatoes |access-date=October 8, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151030232025/http://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/ash-vs-evil-dead/s01/ |archive-date=October 30, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Metacritic]] gave the season a rating of 76 out of 100, based on 32 critics.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.metacritic.com/tv/ash-vs-evil-dead |title=Ash Vs Evil Dead - Season 1 |website=Metacritic |access-date=October 8, 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151105055355/http://www.metacritic.com/tv/ash-vs-evil-dead |archive-date=November 5, 2015 |url-status=live }}</ref>

On Rotten Tomatoes, the second season has a score of 100%, based on 17 reviews, with an average rating of 8.06/10. The site's critical consensus reads, "''Ash vs. Evil Dead''{{'}}s sophomore season proves the show is in command of its characters and tone, turning up the gore, fun, and energy to deliver even more grisly, action-packed thrills and laughs."<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/ash_vs_evil_dead/s02/ |title=Ash vs. Evil Dead: Season 2 |website=Rotten Tomatoes |access-date=January 13, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171127152201/https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/ash_vs_evil_dead/s02 |archive-date=November 27, 2017 |url-status=live }}</ref> On Metacritic, the season has a rating of 82 out of 100, based on five reviews.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.metacritic.com/tv/ash-vs-evil-dead/season-2 |title=Ash Vs. Evil Dead - Season 2 |website=Metacritic |access-date=January 13, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180117072248/http://www.metacritic.com/tv/ash-vs-evil-dead/season-2 |archive-date=January 17, 2018 |url-status=live }}</ref>

The third season has a score of 100% based on 15 reviews on Rotten Tomatoes, with an average rating of 8.32/10. The site's critical consensus reads, "''Ash vs Evil Dead''{{'}}s third and final season rounds out the amiable ensemble with welcome additions and dishes out a series of splatter-filled set-pieces, closing the Necronomicon on the series in gleeful fashion".<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/ash_vs_evil_dead/s03/ |title=Ash vs Evil Dead - Season 3 |website=Rotten Tomatoes |access-date=March 28, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190523194004/https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/ash_vs_evil_dead/s03/ |archive-date=May 23, 2019 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Home media==
On August 23, 2016, [[Anchor Bay Entertainment]], a division of Starz, released the first season of the series on [[Blu-ray]] and [[DVD]].<ref>{{cite web |website=Anchor Bay Entertainment |title=Ash Vs. Evil Dead Season 1 |url=http://www.anchorbayentertainment.com/projects/details/9b209def-6bfb-e511-9488-0e563b5fb261 |access-date=September 8, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160915061556/http://www.anchorbayentertainment.com/projects/details/9b209def-6bfb-e511-9488-0e563b5fb261 |archive-date=September 15, 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref> The second season was released in the fall of 2017.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/Ash-Vs-Evil-Dead-Complete/dp/B072NF3K66 |title=Ash Vs Evil Dead: The Complete Second Season |date=October 23, 2017 |website=Amazon |access-date=January 13, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171029173545/https://www.amazon.co.uk/Ash-Vs-Evil-Dead-Complete/dp/B072NF3K66 |archive-date=October 29, 2017 |url-status=live }}</ref> With season 2 onwards, the future releases were done by [[Lionsgate Home Entertainment]] after the completion of the Starz/Lionsgate merger on December 8, 2016. The third and final season was released in August 2018. A complete collection with all three seasons was released in October 16, 2018.<ref>{{Citation |title=Ash vs Evil Dead: The Complete Collection Blu-ray (Blu-ray + Digital) |url=https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/Ash-vs-Evil-Dead-The-Complete-Collection-Blu-ray/214013/ |access-date=2022-06-02}}</ref>
